aboutPage.name: Hi I'm Yusha | Frontend Developer
content: Hello! Let me briefly introduce myself: I'm Yusha, born in Germany in 2001, and my journey led me to Turkey shortly thereafter, where I continued my education. While studying Computer Engineering at Ankara University, I discovered my passion for frontend development and took it upon myself to self-educate. After laying the foundations with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I delved into React, TypeScript and Next.js.

During my freelancing days, I found great excitement in developing customized tools and websites tailored to the specific needs of my clients. Subsequently, I joined Arksoft as a frontend developer, making a swift transition to the Angular technology the company used within just two weeks.

From the early days, I revamped the company's main and product websites, contributing to significant projects. Simultaneously, I embarked on creating the SEO-friendly website for the Easy2Patch product from scratch. Throughout this period, I actively participated in the development of various B2B products within the company.

Following the successful completion of the Easy2Patch web project, I took on the challenge of building the 4.0 version of the Easy2Patch product for the web, leveraging Windows service technology. Although I am at the early stages of my career, I've been steadily advancing with ambition and determination, continually striving for self-improvement.

Having successfully navigated through various projects, I eagerly anticipate more successes in the future! I believe that overcoming challenges along the way will only strengthen me, bringing me one step closer to achieving my goals.
